# algeria-melbet.com

Public landing pages for `algeria-melbet.com` cover live football, casino games, offers, and partnership information for Algeria. The visible interface supports English, French, and Arabic on the same public URLs.

## Preferred entry points
- https://algeria-melbet.com/ : Homepage with live football, casino games, offers, and mobile-first access content.
- https://algeria-melbet.com/partnership/ : Partnership page with benefits, onboarding steps, partnership models, reporting, and contact paths.
